newsitem.title: USA: Chubb has pact to sell real estate unit-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Chubb has pact to sell real estate unit-WSJ.

text.p: A private company associated with Patriot American Hospitality has agreed in principle to acquire the assets of Chubb Corp's real estate unit for about $1 billion, the Wall Street Journal said in its electronic edition Tuesday.
The report said the company, Patriot American Management and Leasing Co, is run by Paul Nussbaum, the chairman and chief executive of Patriot American Hospitality.

The paper, which attributed its information to people familiar with the matter, said the management company could wrap in Chubb's portfolio of office buildings with its portfolio of 53 hotels and resorts. Alternatively, it could keep the Chubb properties and eventually go public as a separate real estate investment trust, the paper said.
